newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian TV men dress as pilots, board plane.
newsitem.headline: Belgian TV men dress as pilots, board plane.

text.p: Brussels airport authority said on Monday it was taking legal action against two TV programme makers who dressed as pilots and took hidden cameras past security and onto the flight deck of an airliner.
On Sunday BRTN TV showed footage of the duo's trip through Zaventem airport building, on the tarmac and in the cockpit, from cameras which were hidden in bags.
Viewers had earlier been asked whether the two men would succeed in their quest to reach the plane and asked to phone through their opinion. Three out of four believed it could not be done.
Brussels airport authority chairman Eric Kirsch said the incident had been reported to the public prosecutor's office.
Kirsch acknowledged that the two, who wore forged badges, might have been in a position to sabotage a plane but could not have planted a bomb.

"Putting the plane out of order would be quite an embarrassing situation and we will see with the airline once again whether additional measures have to be taken or see whether there was a shortage of planned measures," Kirsch said.
